SUBGROUPS

TRAININGS AND MATCHES AT A GLANCE

ATTENDANCE

You can also assign non-team members to events. If the event is full, the applicant can join the queue and will be informed if the place becomes available. You can easily find out who you can rely on based on the statistics.
 
NOTIFICATION

GALLERY

WALLET
